rootCause: the frozen baseline returns after the first qualifying 5/6-line window, so it cannot represent all systems on a page
whole-page row occupancy >= 0.35 is too conservative for several admitted scanned pages
full-width line bboxes cannot express source line extent, continuity or gap topology

objective: Develop an explicitly versioned deterministic source-only multi-system staff detector on the already-spent 20-page development corpus. The detector must emit sparse five-line system geometry and source-supported line traces without teacher coordinates, page-specific exceptions, training, restored-image access or new holdout access.

inputs.developmentCorpus: the same frozen 20-page V2c development corpus
inputs.teacherTruthUse: evaluation/development feedback only after each source-only raw detector artifact is frozen

outputPerSystem: ordered five line traces or bounded line segments
source-supported x extent for every line
staff spacing estimate derived from source pixels
system bbox derived only from detected source geometry
confidence and abstention reason when applicable

implementationDirection.stage1: Extract near-horizontal source ink support using deterministic binarization plus horizontal stroke/segment evidence robust to scanned-page contrast.
implementationDirection.stage2: Estimate page/local staff spacing from repeated source geometry rather than fixed teacher-derived spacing.
implementationDirection.stage3: Form five-line hypotheses using ordered near-equal spacing and common horizontal support; allow multiple independent systems per page.
implementationDirection.stage4: Resolve overlapping hypotheses using source-only support/regularity with explicit abstention instead of teacher-guided selection.
implementationDirection.stage5: Trace each accepted line over its observed source extent so continuity/gap and mask metrics are measurable.
implementationDirection.note: This is a new versioned detector, not an in-place reinterpretation of stage11-v2c-line-system.v1. The rejected baseline remains immutable evidence.

freezeAndScoreProtocol.phaseA: Run detector with teacher file unavailable to the inference process; persist page inputs/hashes, detector version/config and raw detections; SHA-256 freeze the raw artifact.
freezeAndScoreProtocol.phaseB: Only after Phase A freeze, open the existing completed teacher artifact and score the frozen detections.
metrics: teacher confirmed system count versus predicted system count
line continuity and gap statistics from traced source-supported geometry
freezeAndScoreProtocol.reasonNoThresholdYet: The parent human-mask plan preregistered metrics but no numerical detector adequacy thresholds. The first new detector iteration remains development diagnostic and cannot auto-qualify staff_line.

stopConditions: do not compare restored output if source-detector adequacy is not established
do not access a new independent holdout in this development package
do not promote staff_line based on development data alone
do not modify the frozen Restore package or shared music-safety validator
nextAction: Implement the first source-only multi-system detector iteration and freeze its raw output before teacher scoring.
